label: App icon tile — navy rounded square
revised_prompt: iOS / macOS app icon for Cowork. A rounded-square icon (superellipse, like Apple app icons) filled with deep navy blue. Centered on it: a white flat-vector capybara mark in DeepSeek negative-space style, curled compactly, stout snout, tiny ear, small eye, readable at small size. The icon sits centered on a light gray (#F4F4F5) studio background so we can see the rounded corners. No text, no skeuomorphism, no 3D capybara, no glossy blob, no photoreal fur. Clean product design, high contrast, production app-icon quality. Ultra high resolution.
